title: Tractian Named “Best Meets Requirements” for Mid-Market Asset Management in G2 Summer 2025 Reports
summary: Tractian has earned four G2 badges, including High Performer in CMMS and Asset Management for both Mid-Market and overall segments.
body_markdown:
### Earned four G2 badges, including High Performer in CMMS and Asset Management for both Mid-Market and overall segments


**ATLANTA, July 2025 -** Tractian has been recognized in G2 Summer 2025 Market Reports with top-tier accolades in the Asset Management and CMMS categories, including being the only vendor to receive the “Best Meets Requirements - Mid-Market Asset Management” badge.


This recognition highlights Tractian's commitment to building solutions that actually fit the real needs of maintenance teams. Not just powerful, but practical, usable, and trusted in the field. Tractian’s platform is built to meet the real needs of maintenance teams without the complexity, with fast implementation and integration with the CMMS, ERP, or EAM they already run.


“Customer needs have been our core since day one,” said Igor Marinelli, CEO of Tractian. “This recognition from G2 validates the field-first, results-driven support we deliver to every Maintenance and Reliability team we serve. We’re honored and proud to be building technology that is trusted on the shop floor.”


G2 is a trusted resource for buyers comparing B2B software, and its “Best Meets Requirements” recognition is driven entirely by user feedback, highlighting solutions that outperform expectations across key usability and satisfaction metrics. According to Sydney Sloan, CMO at G2:


“Only about 10% of all vendors on G2 appear in our quarterly Market Reports. Congratulations to Tractian for earning a coveted spot in our reports this season, a recognition powered by the authentic reviews of their customers.”


One such voice is Andy B., an ELT Member at a mid-market manufacturing site, via G2:


“Nothing was too much trouble for them, and they went to the 'nth' degree to understand our business and asset care short & long-term strategic plan. This level of seeking to understand made the implementation particularly user friendly.”


Behind these results is Tractian’s hands-on, field-first approach to implementation and customer support, that spans setup, data migration, and cross-site adoption, ensuring alignment with operational workflows at every stage.


See more from real users:[Explore Tractian reviews on G2](https://www.g2.com/products/tractian-tractian/reviews)


### **About Tractian**


Tractian helps Maintenance and Reliability teams stay ahead of equipment failures and unplanned downtime with AI-powered Condition Monitoring, vibration sensors, maintenance management, and OEE-unified in one platform. Built for the shop floor, Tractian combines ease of use with advanced capabilities, helping industrial teams run safer, more reliable, and more efficient operations. Headquartered in Atlanta, GA, Tractian supports manufacturers globally, with local presence and multi-language support in Mexico City and São Paulo. To learn more, please visit[tractian.com](https://tractian.com/) .

G2 is the world's largest and most trusted software marketplace.
